g.aria-label: Hybrid Interleaving: r = 5 Windowed Layers per 1 Global Layer (Gemma 3)
KV-Cache Fraction: (r · min(n, w) + n) / ((r + 1) n) → 1 / (r + 1)
At w = 1,024, r = 5: Cache drops to 27.1% at n=8K and 16.7% (1/6) asymptotically
Every 6th layer restores direct 1-hop global retrieval across the full context!
